incidents.name: VOW
incidents.notes: vscTokenManager fixed VOW-to-vUSD conversion drained via flash-swap arbitrage across pairs

sources.ref: deployment-basis recheck: VOWToken's nine DELEGATECALL sites all target 0x60ca4ec4412a3b319f4bd6366bb836395336b397, which Etherscan's verified metadata records as the link-time library LToken and which appears as a PUSH20 constant in the runtime - a linked Solidity library address, fixed at deployment and not repointable. callTracer confirms all three delegatecalls in the exploit tx go there, and the token runtime is byte-identical at the creation and incident blocks. Deployment is exact; 1453.2 days.
